name: 2.4/5/6 GHz 14 dBi 8-Element Indoor/Outdoor High Density Patch Antenna with RPSMA
mount_type: Flush mount to wall or articulating wall/pole mount

sources.label: AccelTex Spec Sheet ATS-OHDP-2456-14-8RPSP-36 (Version 1)
sources.note: Legacy AccelTex PDF provided as project sample; public URL not linked yet

field_notes.gain_dbi: Electrical tables list 13/15/15 dBi; marketing title on both sheets says 14 dBi.
field_notes.cable_type: Hubbell SPEC lists ATS-200; AccelTex sheet lists ATS-195. Primary value uses Hubbell (ATS-200).
field_notes.radome: Hubbell SPEC lists ASA; AccelTex sheet lists ABS. Primary value uses Hubbell (ASA).
field_notes.vswr: Taken from AccelTex sheet (<1.5:1, max 2.0). Hubbell lists Voltage Ratio <2.5.
field_notes.weight: Taken from AccelTex sheet (not on Hubbell SPEC).
field_notes.ip_rating: Taken from AccelTex sheet (IP67; not on Hubbell SPEC).
field_notes.included_parts: AccelTex sheet notes articulating wall/pole mount included; Hubbell lists installation type only.
field_notes.bands: 2.4 / 5 / 6 GHz. Hubbell notes outdoor/connectorized 6 GHz use in the U.S. may require pending FCC equipment-approval updates.

internal_notes.maintainer: Seed entry for AntennaComparison scaffold. Compatible AP list is internal-only and must never render in the UI.
